title: Judgment on Babylon Declared

questions.question: "Declare among the nations and proclaim, set up a banner and proclaim, conceal it not, and say: '... is taken, Bel is put to shame, Merodach is dismayed.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:2 (ESV): "Babylon is taken, Bel is put to shame, Merodach is dismayed."

questions.question: "For out of the... a nation has come up against her, which shall make her land a desolation, and none shall dwell in it; both man and beast shall flee away."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:3 (ESV): "For out of the north a nation has come up against her, which shall make her land a desolation,"

questions.question: "In those days and in that time, declares the Lord, the people of Israel and the people of Judah shall come together,... as they come, and they shall seek the Lord their God."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:4 (ESV): "the people of Israel and the people of Judah shall come together, weeping as they come, and they shall seek the Lord their God."

questions.question: "They shall ask the way to Zion, with faces turned toward it, saying, 'Come, let us join ourselves to the Lord in an everlasting... that will never be forgotten.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:5 (ESV): "saying, 'Come, let us join ourselves to the Lord in an everlasting covenant that will never be forgotten.'"

questions.question: "My people have been... sheep. Their shepherds have led them astray, turning them away on the mountains."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:6 (ESV): "My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have led them astray,"

questions.question: "Flee from the midst of Babylon, and go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as... before the flock."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:8 (ESV): "Flee from the midst of Babylon, and go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as male goats before the flock."

questions.question: Why will Babylon be plundered? "Because you are glad, because you rejoice, O destroyers of my... "
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:11 (ESV): "Because you are glad, because you rejoice, O destroyers of my heritage,"

questions.question: "Because of the... of the Lord she shall not be inhabited but shall be an utter desolation;"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:13 (ESV): "Because of the wrath of the Lord she shall not be inhabited but shall be an utter desolation;"

questions.question: "Set yourselves in array against Babylon all around, all you who bend the bow; shoot at her, spare no... , for she has sinned against the Lord."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:14 (ESV): "shoot at her, spare no arrows, for she has sinned against the Lord."

questions.question: "Raise a shout against her all around; she has surrendered; her bulwarks have fallen, her... are thrown down. For this is the vengeance of the Lord:"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:15 (ESV): "she has surrendered; her bulwarks have fallen, her walls are thrown down."

questions.question: "Israel is a hunted... that lions have chased. First the king of Assyria devoured him, and now at last Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has gnawed his bones."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:17 (ESV): "Israel is a hunted sheep that lions have chased."

questions.question: "I will restore Israel to his pasture, and he shall feed on... and in Bashan, and his desire shall be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:19 (ESV): "I will restore Israel to his pasture, and he shall feed on Carmel and in Bashan,"

questions.question: "A sword against the Chaldeans, declares the Lord, and against the inhabitants of Babylon... A sword against her... , that they may become fools!"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:35-36 (ESV): "A sword against the Chaldeans... A sword against her diviners, that they may become fools!"

questions.question: "A drought against her..., that they may be dried up! For it is a land of images, and they are mad over idols."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:38 (ESV): "A drought against her waters, that they may be dried up!"

questions.question: "At the sound of the capture of Babylon the... shall tremble, and her cry shall be heard among the nations."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:46 (ESV): "At the sound of the capture of Babylon the earth shall tremble, and her cry shall be heard among the nations."

key_verse_text: "In those days and in that time... the people of Israel and the people of Judah shall come together, weeping as they come, and they shall seek the Lord their God... saying, 'Come, let us join ourselves to the Lord in an everlasting covenant that will never be forgotten.'"
